dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast white perimeters against a dark grey base. The outer edges are jagged and non-uniform, showing a sharp gradient transition from the dark exterior skin to the high-intensity light ring, often surrounding a darker central core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid white pixel clusters positioned in the interstitial spaces between the larger annuli, concentrated primarily on the mid-lateral flank. These clusters show uniform high-intensity pixel values without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary triad of large annuli on the upper dorsal-lateral region forms an approximate isosceles triangle with the vertex pointing ventrally. Centroids of the most cranial annuli are spaced at a distance roughly equivalent to 1.5 times their own diameter.

other_distinctive_markers: The texture pattern on the anterior neck area transitions from closed loops into elongated, high-contrast linear streaks.
